title: Inkling 2 Mini and leaner models

features.title: Inkling 2 Mini
features.summary: A 26B model with 5.4B active and a 1M context, the strongest for its size.

changes: GGUF image models load with 52 to 66% less RAM on Linux and macOS.
MCP chats process 83 to 87% fewer prompt tokens.
MiniMax-H3-Image renders a new prompt in 36.7 s on 8 GB GPUs, down from 82.7 s.
Scanned PDFs in chat are read with OCR.
